FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: At ClearView Door & Window Solutions, we specialize in the sales and installation of high-quality doors and windows for residential and light commercial properties. Our operations encompass a comprehensive range of services, including free estimates, product consultation, and expert installation by a skilled and trained workforce. We prioritize safety and compliance, ensuring that all our installers undergo thorough safety training and adhere to documented installation procedures. To maintain high standards, we source our products from reputable manufacturers, guaranteeing quality and reliability. Our commitment to customer satisfaction includes post-installation inspections and follow-ups, which further enhance our service reliability and reduce claims related to installation defects. We ensure that all subcontractors working with us possess valid certificates of insurance, thereby minimizing exposure to unforeseen liabilities. Overall, our operations are designed to deliver exceptional value while maintaining industry standards for quality, safety, and customer service.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Loss Date: 06/15/2022; Cause: Minor damage during window installation; Amount: $1,500; Status: Resolved with no further claims.
